title: usenet-ipfs-mail: TLS, integration tests, runbook
description:
Production hardening: rustls-backed HTTPS (cert/key from config, same pattern as usenet-ipfs-reader), E2E integration test (start server in-process, authenticate, Mailbox/get → Email/query → Email/get for a known article), and deployment documentation in docs/RUNBOOK.md.

Why: without TLS, passwords and message content are exposed in transit; without an integration test, the full stack is unverified; without docs, operators cannot deploy.

How to apply: this is the final sub-epic; depends on all others being complete.
